purpose: Bound a modern received-text quotation boundary and one lexical variant without promoting it into a G893 source-original numeral or source-level stemma.

collation.common_opening: 史臣鄭麟趾曰 / 夫治曆明時 [quotation framing is source-specific and not a whole-paragraph authorship grant]
collation.later_sushan_only_anchor: 皇明以來，交通西洋，曆法益明
collation.interpretation: The post-嗚呼 remarks belong to the later Sushan received passage, not to the received Goryeosa vol.50 prefatory text. Same historic subject and quoted opening do not make one witness or authorize attributing the entire Sushan passage to 鄭麟趾.
collation.note: The older transmitted-text incompleteness remark is historiographic context, not proof that GK00893_00 itself has a corrupt 日差 cell or a certain 少/微 radix.
